text:
After departure, a lost note led the welfare officer to ask questions. Lost note review at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

The desk was handling a routine pet travel record when the welfare officer noticed that a handwritten note was no longer with the main file. The note had supported a normal service update for a traveler and pet, and its absence raised a concern about whether all care instructions had been passed along in full. Staff responded in a calm and helpful manner, checked the desk ledger, and compared the active file with the copied service records to confirm the status of the booking and the handoff details.

The review showed no sign that the pet had been placed at risk, but it did show that a change in care notes had not been filed in the usual place. The team then spoke with the traveler to confirm the intended instructions and reviewed the package of documents that accompanied the animal through the desk process. The welfare officer was kept informed in plain language, and the desk made sure the traveler understood what had happened and what had already been verified.

After the immediate check, staff updated the ledger, replaced the missing note with a clear written summary, and added a reminder to keep all service changes together in the file. The desk also checked the transfer path used for the pet so that the same kind of gap would be less likely to happen again. This matter was handled without delay, with attention to the pet's welfare and to the traveler’s confidence in Aurelia Skyways. The follow-up confirmed that the record was complete and that normal care coordination could continue.
